newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Pancontinental gold output down in qtr.
newsitem.headline: Pancontinental gold output down in qtr.

text.p: Pancontinental Mining Ltd (Pancon) said on Wednesday that gold production from its Paddington mine for the three months to March 31 fell to 33,027 ounces from 37,593 a year earlier, but nine-months output rose to 112,075 ounces from 80,517.
Total mill output at Paddington for the quarter was 712,616 tonnes compared with 713,335 a year earlier.
"The total tonnes treated were affected by a SAG mill motor failure which occurred five days before the end of the quarter," Pancon said. It said the failure was rectified in earlier April.
The company said ore grade at 1.6 grams per tonne compared with 1.9 grams per tonne a year earlier because of exceptionally higher grades obtained from the Menzies area.

Pancon said output from its Kundana operation, also in Western Australia, fell to 22,185 ounces in the quarter from 24,129 a year earlier to bring nine-months output to 69,110 ounces from 77,105 a year earlier.
Mill throughput was 160,205 tonnes at an average grade of 5.2 grams per tonne during the quarter. A year earlier, throughput was 121,569 tonnes grading 6.6 grams per tonne.
Pancontinental is about 87.7 percent owned by Goldfields Ltd.
